Description: Lattice constant: In-plane lattice constant of the MXene slab
Stacking sequence: Layer stacking mode (ABA or ABC)
Number of atomic layers: Atomic layers in the slab
M–X interlayer distance: Distance between metal and C/N layers
M–M interlayer distance: Distance between adjacent metal layers
M–X bond length: Bond length between metal and C/N
M–T bond length: Bond length between metal and surface termination
Formation energy: DFT formation energy of the MXene
Bader charge of M1: Bader charge on the primary metal
Bader charge of M2: Bader charge on the secondary metal
Bader charge of X: Bader charge on C or N
Bader charge of T: Bader charge on the surface termination
PBE band gap: Band gap from the PBE functional
Primary metal: Primary metal element
Secondary metal: Secondary metal element (ordered double-metal MXenes)
X element: C or N
Termination type: Surface termination group
Adsorbate species: WGSR-related adsorbate
Dopant element: Substitutional dopant (dopants sheet only)
Adsorption energy: Primary prediction target, Eq. (1)
Activation energy: Used only for the consistency analysis
Reaction energy: Used only for the consistency analysis
